**Every frame the API's four streams push has one typed description.** `docs/reference/events.schema.json`, committed beside `openapi.json` and generated by `python -m openfactory.api.events`, names one envelope — `Envelope`: `kind`, `id`, `at`, `project`, `product` when one applies, `data` — and a data model per kind: `HelloData`, `UpdateData`, `ByeData`, `SubscribedData`, `HistoryData`, `EarlierData`, `SaidData`, `ReplyData`, `StagedData`, `PresenceData`, `AckData`, `RefusedData`, `ResyncData`, `JobsData` (the temporal stream's frame, `jobs: null` when the engine cannot be read), `LogData` (one line of a run's log) and `EndedData`. `product` is required for the kinds a product conversation emits and absent for the rest. The streams themselves send what they sent before.
